svg.title: Where a document with a storage path goes
svg.desc: With Use the storage path of a document in Paperless on, a run asks of every document whether it has a storage path in Paperless. A document without one follows the archive path template. For one with a storage path, the run asks whether the app can render its template: only the variables of the path template, a custom field that Paperless has, and get_cf_value as the one filter. If it can, the document goes below the archive folder to the path of that template, and its file name gets the marker [P123] and its extension. If it can't, because of logic of Jinja, another filter, an unknown variable or a custom field that Paperless lacks, the document follows the archive path template, and the report of the run, the dry-run and the preview name the storage path once. Turning the setting on or off moves the copies as a new template does: each stays the same file, with its shares.
